routes.source_provider: not recorded in derived JSON; source filename is an opaque KMZ name
routes.provenance_and_limitations: Derived local JSON identifies a 2026 KMZ filename; original KMZ/provider metadata is not present in the audited route folder.
routes.whole_course_comparison_decision: assigned ultravasan90-post2023 from the V3 2023+ route-era contract; 2026 derived track is within 246 m p95 of the 2024 track at 0.5 km samples (localized max deviation 763 m); this supports whole-course grouping but not identical checkpoints/segments

result.limitation: coarse nearest-point geometry diagnostic; not a surveyed equivalence proof

whole_course_groups.evidence: V3 route era begins 2023, the 2023-2025 editions use the same 2024 reference geometry, 2026 has a year-tagged derived route and has aligned official distance plus close sampled track geometry.
whole_course_groups.limitations: Track similarity is not proof of identical segment/checkpoint semantics; segment analysis remains CourseVersion-specific.

method_limitations: The repository has no edition-specific GPS tracks for every RaceEdition; reference geometry is not treated as exact route evidence.
The sampled nearest-track distance is a diagnostic and cannot establish course identity on its own.
No whole-course comparison group is assigned without edition-specific evidence; checkpoint contracts remain separate from route identity.
